Keyboard accessibility and focus
management

Interactive UI must support keyboard use, visible focus and accessible names. Use native buttons/inputs
when possible. Manage focus when opening and closing dialogs, and avoid keyboard traps.

Mouse එකක් නැති user JකJනක්ට Tab, Enter, Space සහ Escape වලින් UI use කරන්න පුළුවන් Jවන්න ඕJන්. Native buttons keyboard behavior ලබාJදනවා. Dialog එක open කරද්දී focus එක ඇතුළට යවලා close වුණාම open කළ button එකට ආපසු Jදන්න.
Open and close an accessible modal using a keyboard.
Trigger focused Open dialog Focus inside · Close dialog Restore focus to trigger
Read the diagram: Trigger focused → Open dialog → Focus inside. Close dialog → Restore focus to trigger.
Open button එJකන් dialog එකට focus යනවා. Dialog close වුණාම trigger එකට focus ආපසු යනවා.

Expected result: Dialog opens modally with browser-managed focus behavior; closing restores focus to the
trigger.
Interview question: Why use a real button instead of a clickable div?

Answer: Native buttons provide semantics and keyboard activation automatically; a div needs extra
work to match them.
Remember: Native controls first; restore focus.
Practice: Test the dialog using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Escape.
